episode.title: This GIANT KOMODO DRAGON Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a desert ruins set, a colossal Komodo dragon lunges to consume a performer, only for its fabricated jaws to be manually opened by the crew to release him.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators with their rigs in the foreground. One giant creature faces exactly one man, who stands his ground and watches its jaws begin to part.

SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators in the foreground. One colossal greyish-brown Komodo dragon, with tough, scaly skin, piercing yellow eyes, and a wide, powerful mouth filled with jagged, venomous teeth, its head stretching over six metres high, faces Ihsan, who stands his ground on the desert floor and watches its jaws begin to part. Ambient sound only: shifting sand, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The creature's jaws open wide and close over exactly one man until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with the man nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The colossal greyish-brown Komodo dragon, with tough, scaly skin, piercing yellow eyes, and a wide, powerful mouth filled with jagged, venomous teeth, its head stretching over six metres high, opens its jaws wide and closes over Ihsan until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with Ihsan nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming. Ambient sound only: shifting sand, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 3, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. Crew members put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and the same one man climbs out of the mouth onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal.

SHOT 3, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. Crew members put their hands on the colossal Komodo dragon's jaws and manually swing them open, revealing the sculpted fibreglass shell and visible internal pin, and Ihsan climbs out of the mouth onto the desert set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal. Ambient sound only: shifting sand, studio air handling and distant crew movement.
